title: Safai Saathi design tokens
description: The shared visual vocabulary. PRD-2 section 0.5: the same token names must exist in the Flutter theme and the admin panel's CSS variables. The values here are the platform's default. A screen may override a value locally, but it must use the same token NAME.
x-rule: Colors ONLY via the token. Spacing ONLY via the token. Radius ONLY via the token. A raw hex or a numeric padding literal in a screen is a bug. This is the same law as CL-D01 to CL-D31 in the driver app's design spec.

primary.note: The brand green. The primary CTA's fill.

statusReceived.note: The complaint status. ALWAYS colour plus icon plus label, never colour alone.

statusEscalated.note: The error colour family. For validation and failure messages only.

unit.note: All spacing is a multiple of this.

family.note: Noto Sans covers both Latin and Gujarati. The admin panel needs the Gujarati face if it ever renders notice text a driver will read.

x-app-accessibility.note: The driver app uses driver sizes everywhere. The user app uses user sizes. Never mix them.
